title: deployment-cadence-check-in-and-queue-health
content:
Purpose: mid-week checkpoint focused on deployment cadence, hotfix queue health, and decisions for the next release train. Notes taken live during Wednesday standup (15:00 PST). Informal — action owners + deadlines included.

Attendees: Priya Kapoor (chair), Marcus Li (SRE), Evelyn Shaw (Release Eng), Diego Ramos (Platform), Ruth Chen (QA), + ad-hoc: Omar (SeqInfra)

Summary bullets:
- Queue length: current patch queue = 9 (3 high-priority hotfixes, 6 standard deferred patches). Target before next gate: <= 5.
- Median preflight turnaround: 6h (goal 4h). Bottleneck: integration tests on cudatest-7 shard.
- Canary anomaly: small uptick in token-latency p95 for model rwd-13B-quant on gpu-pool-b during canary window at 03/09 02:12 PST. Root-cause suspected: host-level NVLINK flapping; correlates with infra reboots from kernel updates.
- Release train cadence: next train window scheduled 2026-03-17 22:00 UTC. Freeze starts 2026-03-16 18:00 UTC.

Detailed notes:
1) Hotfix queue triage
   - JIRA-RELEASE-8021: customer-facing embedding mismatch — P1. Status: patch branch created, unit tests green, integration failing intermittently on cuda shard. Owner: Ruth. Action: Ruth to attach failing log excerpt and re-run tests in isolated node by 2026-03-11 12:00 PST. If flake persists, escalate to infra for hardware repro.
   - JIRA-RELEASE-8004: SSL renewal path missing for private-deployments agent — scheduled hotfix, P2. Owner: Diego. Plan: ship hotfix 2026-03-12 morning with rollback tag v3.4.2-rc1. 
   - JIRA-RELEASE-7999: Prometheus scrape spike during rollout — monitoring rule adjusted; Marcus to validate spike suppression by 2026-03-12 EOD.

2) Canary observations and mitigations
   - Sequence: Canary run of rwd-13B-quant (canary channel) executed 03/09 01:40-03:40. Noted p95 latency +12% vs baseline for short prompts (<64 tokens). No error rate increase.
   - Cross-checks done: compared run to dedicated pool (gpu-pool-a) and saw no anomaly. Root hypothesis: distribution of long-running background batch jobs on gpu-pool-b pegging NVLINK bandwidth.
   - Short-term mitigation: add placement constraint to avoid co-location with batch jobs for next canary (PR: infra#614). Marcus to merge if validation passes.

3) Preflight and gating metrics (new intake items)
   - SLOs to pass gate: build success, infra-health (node_restarts < 1 per hour per pool), canary-latency delta < 8%, and roll-forward tests green.
   - Current failures: infra-health metric breached once (see canary anomaly). Decision: keep train on schedule but tighten rollback triggers. If canary-latency delta > 10% during next run, auto-abort.

4) Capacity and autoscale notes
   - Observed evening throughput spike on 03/08 (customer traffic) increased queueing latency for async requests by ~18%. Autoscaler delayed spinup by ~90s on gpu-pool-b due to cold cache of images. Action: Diego to add warming job to trigger image prefetch 10m before predicted spike windows (implementation via cronjob + predictive schedule). Target: 2026-03-14.

5) Testing and flakiness hotspots
   - flaky-tests: integration/test_infer_timeout and integration/test_kv_cache_eviction. Both flake more on cudatest-7. QA runbook update: annotate these tests as flaky and move to nightly stress with additional telemetry. Ruth to file follow-up tickets with logs by 2026-03-13.

6) Rollback policy refinements (decisions taken)
   - New temporary rule for this train: if any canary node shows p99 latency regression > 25% or error rate increase > 0.5% absolute, immediate rollback to previous deployment.
   - For non-critical (P2+) patches, allow staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 30-min observation windows between stages. Evelyn to codify these thresholds in the rollout config by 2026-03-13.

7) Action item list (owner — due)
   - Ruth Chen — attach failing logs for RELEASE-8021 + re-run isolated test (2026-03-11 12:00 PST)
   - Marcus Li — validate prometheus spike suppression and merge placement-constraint PR if checks pass (2026-03-12 EOD)
   - Diego Ramos — implement image prefetch warming job and document schedule (2026-03-14)
   - Evelyn Shaw — update rollout config with temporary thresholds + add automatic abort on canary >10% delta (2026-03-13)
   - Priya Kapoor — final gate checklist and communication to release-ops channel 2026-03-16 09:00 PST

Open questions / notes to follow up:
- Is the NVLINK flapping recurring for older kernels? Omar to run hardware diagnostics and share findings. If recurring, we need to mark affected hosts and exclude from canaries.
- Do we want to permanently add image prefetch for all pools, or only for high-traffic pools? Cost tradeoff analysis required. Diego to estimate compute/storage cost impact.
- Test flakiness: move to triage with infra ownership for repro attempts. Consider adding deterministic replay harness to isolate timing.

Meeting close: agreed to reconvene ad-hoc if any canary threshold is breached. Next formal check-in: Friday standup 2026-03-13 15:00 PST.

Appendix (short logs & refs):
- Canary run id: canary-2026-03-09-01 (see infra dashboard link in linked_artifacts)
- Quick commands (for owners):
   - rerun integration on isolated node: scripts/test-run.sh --node cudatest-7 --tag isolated
   - compare latency histograms: scripts/compare-latency.sh canary-2026-03-09-01 baseline-2026-02-28

Notes-to-self: capture perf dump for rwd-13B-quant if we see repeat regression. Also, add a short blurb to release-notes about hotfix prioritization criteria so PMs have visibility.
